reader.requirement: At --std 85 each executed RELEASE must put the record named by record-name-1 (the record area's content at that moment, after the implicit MOVE of a FROM phrase) into the sort file's initial phase, once, so it is among the records the sort returns; for a variable-length SD the released size follows §1985:VII.3.8.4 GR10, and for an SD with no RECORD clause whether its records are fixed or variable is implementor defined (§1985:II.2.1.4.3).

edition-consulted.switches: rangeFailsStatement = DialectLevel < 2002: at 85 a record outside the VARYING range is not released (GR10's Amendment 2 paragraph); from 2002 EC-SORT-MERGE-RELEASE, and with checking off the record is released
FROM literal-1 is refused below 2002 (COBOL0871, construct from-literal-2002)

reader.edition-search: grep for DialectLevel, DialectBehavior, Constructs, IsActive in SortBinder.cs, SortEmitter.cs, CobolSort.cs and VersionConformancePass.cs; the release itself (EmitRelease, ReleaseStatement) is one path with the edition passed in only as rangeFailsStatement.
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: yes: at 85 an out-of-range RELEASE of a VARYING SD releases nothing, and RELEASE FROM a literal is refused; a record within range is released by the same code at every edition.

reader.notes: BindRelease resolves record-name-1 to an SD record, binds FROM as the implicit MOVE, and EmitRelease hands the record area image to CobolSort.ReleaseStatement, which adds one frame to the sort store. A shorter record of a multi-01 SD with no RECORD clause releases the whole 6-position area, the implementor's fixed-length choice §1985:II.2.1.4.3 leaves open (docs/conformance DOC-A.1-147); the positions past record-name-1 are undefined after RETURN (§1985:XI.4.3.4 GR1). All probes matched.

refuter.evidence: q5a at --std 85: two SDs with the same 01 name REC, RELEASE REC OF SA FROM W-E (I) in a paragraph of another section PERFORMed VARYING I from the input procedure (subscript changing per execution), then a plain RELEASE REC OF SA with SAME RECORD AREA FOR SA FX: R A111 / R B222 / R C333 / R D444 / R Zzzz, CNT 05 (each executed RELEASE one record, from the right SD), SRA [Zzzz] (record still available through the SAME RECORD AREA, GR2). q1h: RELEASE FROM a group in a VARYING SD released at DEPENDING size. q1g: RELEASE FROM literal refused COBOL0871 at 85 (1985 format is FROM identifier-1). cite.py: OK §1985:XI.4.2.4 GR1; OK §1985:XI.4.2.4 GR2. The case-1 defect (a table element as RECORD DEPENDING ON, ignored) also affects the released size, but it belongs to the RECORD clause rule (1985-GR-XI.3.2.4-2), not to GR1's transfer of the record.
